headline: Two dragons, two controllers
lede: Double Dragon's oldest honest gap — two humans always cramped at one keyboard — closed: the blue seat now takes a friend's own gamepad or linked iPhone, and the first button press hands them Jimmy for the run.

notes.text: A second pad or a phone at /retrogames/pad drives Jimmy Lee: d-pad walks the street, A jumps, B kicks, square/triangle/LB punches — the same physical layout player one's thumb already knows. Keyboard WASD+F/G/V still works and unions with the pad; ?solo=1 still declines.

The seat reads onePad slot 2 — the layer #492 built for second pads and #893 for phones. The pad gained the phone's third-action channel (boost ← square/triangle/LB), and one pure module (p2pad.js) owns all translation, pinned by a hash-equivalence law: the same stream through keys or through slot 2 lands on identical state hashes, 240 ticks deep.

ddragoncheck 126/126 with 12 named mutants (new seat-swap: the friend's jump migrates and the pins scream); vpadcheck 714/714 keeps every other title's pad untouched. Next on this shelf: the remaining DD gaps — chain scoring is the meatiest — plus three open polish passes (#2852, #2857, #2863) for the QA lane.

look.text: FROGGER: frogger pins its certified seed (red-main fix #601)
